notes.title: Oculus quest link is not much playable
notes.notes:
Tested Oculus quest 2 with both link cable and virtual desktop. 
Performance issue is too critical that game runs below 50fps, forces player to lower resolution per eye option.
I have tried to fix this, but could not found satisfying result. 
GPU resource is share by game and image stream compression for Oculus Quest.
If I grow frame rate of game, the image Quest receives makes afterimage.
If I remove afterimage of Quest, the frame rate of game drop below 50fps.
Maybe this problem can be solved in the future by hardware manufacturers, but that is out of my work.




Other update applied while uploading patch for oculus

Chages- NPC face cosmetic returned, jump input from joystick disabled.

Minor bug fix- face and body color matches after wearing thigh high.
player collision follows player location when player start to move again. this fixes problem when player have wide VR room.
 
Critical bug fix- when player run away from town while pursued by guards, bugs about crime and combat don't happen anymore.

notes.title: Update 03/04
notes.notes:
Survival mode- If you enable this, you have to eat food to survive. Eating un-purchased food counted as crime. So it is important you collect food from farm.
Royal shop sells bread with expensive price. 
If your save file is non survival mode, you can enable after load by clicking system-enable survival mode button.
When you lose fight, you lost food gauge. If you die with 0 food gauge, that means permanent death.

Investment- You can invest Peji from royal shop. you can collect tax every two days if you invested more than 5000 peji. Investment interface say you will get access to forbidden zones but that is not updated yet.

Reroll contract- you can reroll contract. You can reroll only nearby town contract.





Improvement- Frame drop happened every 30 second removed. Instead, it happens one time whenever you move 1.2km distance.
Royal shop item shows icon.

Added- jump key is bind to right controller. It would be changed in future. 

Changes- Small ships move faster. you should sell and buy your ship to apply update.
Cascade movement is default option.


Next update going to be pickpocket and sneak system, openable tutorial books, ship stat rebalance, companion interaction.
